text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut. Burning with 
ambition, El Condor Pasa feels the day to 
spread her wings to the world has arrived. 
But...

She was disappointed by the lack of 
overseas reporters, but she fired herself 
up to make her presence known right here.

With the cheers of her classmates at her 
back, and aiming to make her name known 
across the world... she dashed out into 
the "Make a Debut" race.
